visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair tied back wears a green t-shirt in a brightly lit indoor home environment. She holds a black smartphone box and carefully peels a plastic seal with her right hand. The background shows a white wall and a computer monitor setup. (2) A close-up shot features the back of a silver smartphone with four distinct black camera lenses. The lighting reflects off the metallic surface, showing a blueish-purple tint on the glass. (3) The woman holds an orange product box for a screen protector. She points at the instructions on the back with her left index finger, which has a gold-glittered manicure. (4) In a medium shot, she holds the screen protector kit from TORRAS. She gestures with her hands as she speaks to the camera. A white dog appears briefly at the bottom of the frame. (5) She wipes the screen of a black smartphone with a small white wet wipe in a top-down camera angle. The setting is a white desk surface with various cables and objects. (6) She places a plastic alignment tool marked with the brand name over the phone. Her hands are steady as she aligns the edges. (7) She pulls a long orange plastic tab out from the alignment tool while holding the frame down with her left hand. The tab has black text printed on it. (8) She removes the top plastic layer from the alignment tool, revealing the newly applied screen protector. She then uses a small white card to scrape across the surface to remove air bubbles. (9) A close-up of the phone screen shows a purple moon wallpaper with a digital fingerprint icon at the bottom. The screen reflects the surrounding light clearly. (10) The woman smiles and gives a thumbs-up to the camera while holding the phone. She then holds up the product packaging featuring a picture of a male celebrity.

A female voice speaks in an energetic, friendly tone, narrating the purchase of a new smartphone. (2) A sharp crinkling sound of plastic being peeled occurs as the narrator describes the unboxing process. The BGM maintains its rhythm underneath the speech. (3) A muffled cardboard shuffling sound is audible as the product box is handled. The narrator's speech rate remains moderate with high pitch variability indicating excitement. (4) A distinct 'click' sound is heard, resembling a plastic frame being snapped into place on a hard surface. The BGM swells slightly in the background. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' or tearing sound occurs as the orange tab is pulled from the alignment tool. The narrator's voice exhibits higher arousal, expressing surprise and tension. (6) A repetitive scraping or swiping sound follows, created by a card moving across a glass surface. The BGM continues with its consistent electronic beat. (7) The narrator's tone shifts to a satisfied, positive valence as the installation concludes. A final 'pop' or digital transition sound effect highlights the success of the fingerprint sensor test. The BGM fades out at the end.
